title: The Theology of Plato and Elements of Theology
author: Proclus (Taylor trans)
description: Thomas Taylor presents works by Proclus on the structure of divine reality and the principles of Neoplatonic philosophy. They examine unity, causation and the ordered relationships between gods, intellect and soul.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/thomastaylor).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
